text:
sara_oncall: :rotating_light: incident bot alerted: hf-hosting returned 429s for artifact GETs across eu and us-west regions starting ~2143456500. seeing model fetch failures during cold starts.

incident-bot: Alert: HuggingFace asset hosting rate limit spike detected. metric: hf_asset_fetch_429 rate from 0.02% -> 3.1% in 5m. Pager duty routed to @sara_oncall.

sara_oncall: reproducing — trying a request to prod mirror: `curl -I https://hf-hosting.prod/models/rdw/small/weights.bin` returns `HTTP/1.1 429` and `Retry-After: 10`.

mike_infra: confirmed. our artifact proxy pool is seeing a backlog: artifact_fetch_queue_length ~ 420 (baseline 8). Prefetch workers are being throttled upstream.

nyla_support: Customer alerts started coming in 2m ago. Support ticket queue: 14 tickets reporting slow/failed model loads. Most impact on new requests after scale-to-zero.

alan_ml: cold starts > 20s for some models. KV cache misses spiking. This is causing user-facing latency and some timeouts.

julia_prod: dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/asset-fetch shows region heatmap + spike in `model_load_time_p50/p95`.

sara_oncall: immediate mitigation options?

mike_infra: short list: 1) enable our fallback mirror (rdw-mirror-1) for reads only (can be rate-limited but more capacity). 2) temporarily increase prefetch workers (use reserved pool) to warm caches. 3) enable aggressive KV prefix caching for recent models. 4) apply circuit-breaker to upstream HF fetches (fail fast + use cached variants).

alan_ml: prefer 1 + 3 + 4. prefetching too many concurrently may worsen upstream rate limits. we should pace prefetch with token bucket.

sara_oncall: starting step 1 — routing reads to rdw-mirror-1 via routing-policy `hf-hosting-fallback` (non-disruptive). Applying now.

deploy-bot: Command accepted: `set-routing hf-hosting -> rdw-mirror-1 (reads only)` by sara_oncall at 2143456832.

mike_infra: routing change applied. watching queue.

nyla_support: ticket update: "We've routed reads to fallback mirror; may still see transient failures. ETA for more mitigation 10-15m." Posting to customers now.

alan_ml: enabling KV prefix caching for recent model versions (30m TTL). This will avoid upstream hits for repeated small requests.

julia_prod: applied TTL change (`kv_cache.ttl_models=1800`).

sara_oncall: enabling circuit breaker for HF upstream (threshold: 5xx/429 > 0.5% in 1m => failfast to fallback).

deploy-bot: Circuit breaker rule created `hf_upstream_cb_v1` by sara_oncall at 2143456901.

mike_infra: queue length dropping to ~60. artifact_fetch_errors down from 3.1% -> 0.9% after routing + cache change. still above baseline but improving.

nyla_support: customer tickets reduced to 5. Notifying affected customers about temporary fallback and potential degraded perf.

alan_ml: observed side-effect: some inference requests served slightly stale model variants from mirror (mirror behind by 1 commit for two models). recommend informing customers if strict model pinning required.

sara_oncall: noted. adding pinned-model check to the fallback path so we fail instead of silently returning older artifact for pinned deployments. applying now for critical tenants.

deploy-bot: Patch deployed to fallback path: respect `model_pin` header for critical tenants.

mike_infra: telemetry: `origin_retry_after` header present on majority of 429s — HF upstream is actively rate-limiting. Suggest reaching out to HF support if this persists > 60m.

sara_oncall: set SRE -> contact huggingface support channel, send summary and request immediate remediation.

alan_ml: runbook note: if artifact fetch fails at scale, prefer mirror + circuit-breaker + limited prefetch. do not scale prefetch unbounded.

nyla_support: posting brief status update to status.redwood: "Partial degradation: model cold starts may fail or be slow for new requests. Mitigation in place (fallback mirror)."

julia_prod: starting a 30m bridge with infra + ml + support. invite link: https://meet.redwood/bridges/2143456905

sara_oncall: incident severity: S2 (customer impact but degraded overall service, not full outage). recording now.

mike_infra: additional mitigation: bump artifact proxy concurrency per-worker by +2 to drain backlog (safe). Applying to 3 nodes now.

deploy-bot: Roll command accepted: `scale artifact-proxy workers +2 on nodes group b` by mike_infra at 2143456958.

mike_infra: nodes updated. queue draining faster. p95 model_load_time down from 32s -> 10s for warmed requests. Cold-start p95 still ~18s.

nyla_support: customers acknowledged update. one enterprise customer (org: Nimbly) requested SLA credit evaluation — escalated to account team.

alan_ml: capturing logs for postmortem: `grep 'hf 429' /var/log/artifact-proxy/*.log | head -n 200` — sampling shows many `Retry-After: 15` and intermittent 503s.

sara_oncall: handoff plan: I'm staying on for 15m, then handing to night oncall @mike_infra. create a short playbook for the next oncall: what we did, current status, and steps to escalate to HF.

mike_infra: ack. I'll continue monitor and coordinate with HF support.

julia_prod: adding runbook link & notes: https://confluence.redwood/ops/hf_artifact_throttle_runbook — updated with actions taken.

nyla_support: pushed final customer update: "Mitigations active; new requests routed to fallback. We will notify when upstream is stable. " :thumbsup:

sara_oncall: final notes before handoff: - routing -> rdw-mirror-1 in place - circuit breaker active - KV caches TTL=1800 - artifact proxies scaled +2 - monitoring alerts set for hf_asset_fetch_429 and artifact_fetch_queue_length - open bridge link (monitoring)

sara_oncall: handing off to @mike_infra at 2143457045. Please escalate to HF support if rate limits persist beyond 60m.

mike_infra: taking over. will post updates and notify if we need contact-level escalation.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: id=INC-2143, severity=S2, responders=[sara_oncall,mike_infra,alan_ml,nyla_support], start=2143456500.

julia_prod: :spiral_notepad: I'll draft a short post-incident note with time-series snippets and affected customers list.

sara_oncall: thanks all.

mike_infra: continuing watch. will close thread once HF confirms recovery or we remove fallback.
